review_note: Drafted 2026-11-04 from the native enrollment test fixtures (AddNamingProfileFixture, AddCollisionPolicyFixture). Marked for owner review. Updated 2026-11-14 for owner rulings Q177 and Q180-Q183 (upper ASCII fold of unquoted names, quoted names keep their case, one shared key lane).
review_flags: Q177/Q180-Q183 (owner 2026-11-14): unquoted names fold to upper case, ASCII letters only (hello, Hello and HELLO are one name); a quoted name keeps its case and is compared exactly ("HELLO" and "Hello" are two names); an unquoted name and a quoted name collide when the quoted spelling equals the unquoted name folded (hello and "HELLO"). Non-ASCII letters are not folded until a case-folding resource is declared in the pack. (Was: comparison_mode exact makes every catalog name case-sensitive and unfolded in the default identifier profile.)

One collision group binds every built-in record kind with exact language tags and one shared key lane: each name is compared by its own lane's key (folded when unquoted, exact when quoted). (Was: One collision group binds every built-in record kind with exact language tags and separate key lanes.)
